chapter: Union, New Orleans and King Oliver
title: Army camps and theaters
summary: Allen asks if the band played Army camps or theaters; Reason says camps came after 1941.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Did you ever play in any Army camps or anything? No. There wasn't such thing as that around those times. Yeah. See, Army camps started getting popular after December 7th, 1941. Would you ever play in a warehouse? I don't remember.
And, yeah, that's just a long time ago. And, uh, theaters. Did you ever play much in theaters then?
